card.name: The word pairs after two
card.fires_on: The word "pairs" right after "Two" or "2" in lists of items, and to a lesser extent "of" or "twins" after a count of two.

modes.label: Two pairs
modes.description: "pairs" directly after the number two, naming equipment such as gloves, forceps or antennas.
modes.example: - Two<< pairs>> of Latex, or other sterile gloves

modes.label: Of or twins after two
modes.description: "of" after "two" or "pairs", or "twins" in a context about two offspring.
modes.example: Two<< of>> these patients had underlying renal impairment or risk
